description: Ranked list of regions by a housing metric. sort_by="value" (default) ranks by the latest value: metric=zhvi direction=top → most expensive metros, direction=bottom → cheapest. sort_by="growth" ranks by percent change over a trailing window (growth_window_months, default 12): direction=top → FASTEST-GROWING / fastest-appreciating metros, direction=bottom → biggest decliners. metric defaults to zhvi (home values). Returns up to 100 rows.

growth_window_months.description: Trailing window for sort_by=growth, in months (default 12).

metric.description: One of: zhvi | zori | sales_count | median_sale_price | inventory | new_listings (default zhvi)

sort_by.description: value (latest level, default) | growth (percent change over growth_window_months)

name: zillow_top_markets
